name: Bend, OR

settings.reroofPermitCoverageNote: Bend requires permits for residential reroofing, so permit history is a strong roof-age signal.

arcgisPermits.where: (DeptCode='BLD' AND (TypeDesc IN ('New Construction/Installation','Renovation/Alteration','Addition') OR UPPER(ApplicationDescription) LIKE '%ROOF%' OR UPPER(ApplicationDescription) LIKE '%SHINGLE%')) OR UPPER(ApplicationDescription) LIKE '%SOLAR%' OR UPPER(ApplicationDescription) LIKE '%PHOTOVOLTAIC%'

addresses.where: taxlot IS NOT NULL AND status='Current'

improvements.where: Taxlot LIKE '1711%' OR Taxlot LIKE '1712%' OR Taxlot LIKE '1811%' OR Taxlot LIKE '1812%'

notes: First live validation market: residential reroofs require permits here.
Weather: NWS Pendleton (PDT) Local Storm Reports via IEM.
Permits: City of Bend Permit Applications Point (CityView). Descriptions only exist from ~late 2020; pre-2020 reroofs are not identifiable.
Properties: City BLIS single-family parcels + City site address points + Deschutes County assessor improvements (year built).
Solar: only described (post-2020) solar permits are identifiable; legacy electrical permits have no description.
